steps.what: Read work orders and recipes to determine cooking times, temperatures and ingredient specifications

tasks.design: Keep reading and checking the applicable instructions with the operator. Present the controlled recipe through existing {DOCS} or {OPS_SYSTEM} access.
tasks.previous_blocker: The operator must establish which instructions apply to the actual batch.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing recipe records can provide controlled instructions without generating new process settings.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising conflicting versions, ingredient substitutions or instructions that do not match the batch.
tasks.human_edge: The operator notices when the written instructions do not fit the work in front of them.

reach.learn: Which discrepancies require a revised instruction

evidence.claim: Aptean Bakery ERP stores formulas; this does not establish that an operator can omit reading applicable cooking instructions.

assumptions: Boundary is reading and understanding instructions, not preparing recipes or setting equipment.

Production planner supplies the work order and authorised recipe owner supplies the controlled version; operator verifies batch identity, revision, quantities, units, times and temperatures during s1. Missing or conflicting instructions go to the supervisor.
Use the existing controlled-recipe view first.
No incremental upkeep is added because no new extraction or recipe-generation service is introduced.
research_questions: Are reading delays caused by finding the right version or understanding its content?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; zero gross and net saving. Reading and batch applicability checks retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Observe cooking conditions and adjust controls

steps.what: Observe gauges and product characteristics and adjust temperature, pressure and ingredient flow controls

tasks.design: Retain physical observation and control adjustment with the operator. Use {OTHER}, the cooking-equipment controller, according to the applicable process instructions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual product behaviour and equipment conditions need direct observation.
tasks.enabler_now: Current equipment controls assist the operator; this design introduces no process-control retrofit.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising abnormal product characteristics and responding to changing conditions.
tasks.human_edge: The operator combines instrument readings with what the product is doing.

reach.learn: When the process needs escalation rather than another adjustment

evidence.claim: Live cooking control and product observation are physical operational work; no new control capability is established by the digest.

assumptions: Boundary is actual observation and adjustment, not recording a separate batch report.
Operator observes gauges and product characteristics during s1 and checks applicable instructions from the reading task. No ready product-quality or correct-adjustment flag is assumed.
Use existing equipment controls first; automatic controller runtime is not human effort.
No incremental upkeep is introduced because no new control automation is proposed.
research_questions: Which adjustments depend on product observations that current instruments do not capture?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; zero gross and net saving. Live observation and existing controller runtime receive no claimed reduction.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Record cooking production and test data

steps.what: Read and capture actual processing steps, readings, cooking times, batches and test results
Compile production and test data into the batch record without repeated transcription
Check recorded production data and resolve missing or incorrect batch entries

tasks.design: Capture actual readings once through a native batch form in {OPS_SYSTEM} and configure the batch record from those entries. Keep reading instruments, obtaining test results and resolving missing data with the operator.
tasks.previous_blocker: Paper entries may be recopied into a second batch record.
tasks.enabler_now: Native production forms can retain the primary entry and assemble the record without another transcription.
tasks.still_hard: Correct batch linkage, missing observations, unit errors and results that arrive after production.
tasks.human_edge: The operator checks that recorded values represent actual observations rather than plausible defaults.
tasks.altitude: Reduce duplicate recording while retaining actual observation and verification.

reach.task: Provide identified test results and correction references
reach.learn: Which results remain pending when the production record is checked

evidence.claim: A native batch form can reuse a verified primary entry; this cooking-record design and its saving remain unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is recording observed production and completed test data, not performing the cooking or tests again.

Operator produces the primary record in s1: batch identifier, step, observation timestamp, temperature and steam values with units, cooking start and end, quantity and test reference. Quality staff produce actual test results; s1 includes obtaining and checking their identity, timestamp, value and unit. Pending tests stay pending.
S2 uses only s1 entries; missing values stop for manual completion in s3. No sensor feed, automatic process-step flag or laboratory integration is assumed.
Test native batch forms first and verify that duplicate transcription exists. If records already compile automatically, existing runtime earns no saving.
research_questions: Can single-entry batch records remove recopying without increasing missing or mislinked readings?

already_counted.description: Actual observation capture, result collection and record checking

incremental.description: Maintain entry fields and sample batch linkage and missing-value behaviour
Maintain native form configuration and access

approvals.approved_version: Exact batch record, primary entries, result references and unresolved items; any correction creates a renewed review version

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=55+0+20=75; gross 25 minus focal upkeep 6 gives net 19 in an E1 duplicate-record scenario. Range 0-5 allows existing automatic compilation and low duplicate-entry effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Respond to malfunction alarms and notify supervisors

steps.what: Listen for malfunction alarms and shut down equipment when required by actual conditions
Notify supervisors of the malfunction, equipment state and required follow-up

tasks.design: Retain alarm response and shutdown with the operator using {OTHER}, the equipment controls. Notify the supervisor directly through {TELEPHONY} after the immediate response.
tasks.previous_blocker: The operator must recognise the actual equipment state and act promptly.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing alarms and controls support the response; no new automatic shutdown or notification service is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Ambiguous alarms, unsafe conditions and explaining the current state accurately.
tasks.human_edge: The operator responds to the real situation and confirms the supervisor understands the concern.

reach.learn: Which state information is needed immediately

evidence.claim: Physical alarm response and immediate supervisor communication remain operational work; no supported automation saving is established.

assumptions: Boundary is alarm response, shutdown and notification, not repair or restart authorisation.

Equipment produces alarms; operator observes the state and produces the malfunction concern and shutdown information in s1 before s2 uses them. No free structured fault or shutdown-complete signal is assumed.
Use current alarms and procedures first; existing interlock runtime earns no labour saving.
Incremental upkeep is zero because no new notification or shutdown automation is introduced.
research_questions: Which alarm responses require immediate physical observation before any message can be prepared?

already_counted.description: Alarm response and direct supervisor notification

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=85+15=100; zero gross and net saving. Alarm response and notification retain their time.

reach: Check result identity and timing with quality staff
